description: Delete a single item by ID. Use `text` for text nodes, sticky notes and link capsules in `texts[]`, `line` for strokes in `lines[]`, or `image` for images in `images[]`. Confirm the item's ID and kind with `get_board` before deleting. Success means the item is absent, including if it was already absent.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.

name: erase
title: Erase Item
